upload.title: Upload recordings
upload.intro: Choose up to 20 videos or audio files at once. Each one is checked straight away: if it is already in the archive you will see it here, and you decide.
upload.badLink: This link is incomplete. Please ask the admin for the upload link again.
upload.tooMany: Only {max} files per batch. {count} were left out — send this batch first, then add them.

status.checking: Checking whether it is already in the archive…
status.rejected: Exactly this file is already in the archive. It was not uploaded again.
status.rejectedPending: Exactly this file was already uploaded — by another brother, or earlier in this batch. It was not uploaded again.
status.candidates: Possibly already in the archive — please check

error.no_readable_audio: This file has no sound that could be read. Is it a photo or a screen recording?
error.upload_key_required: The upload link is not valid any more. Please ask the admin for the current link.

candidate.pending: A recording like this was already uploaded — by another brother, or earlier in this batch. It has not been reviewed yet.
candidate.withheld: A recording like this is already in the archive.

upload.send: Send {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

blocked.busy: Wait until every file is checked.
blocked.undecided: Decide for every file marked “please check”.
blocked.empty: There is nothing new to send.
blocked.name: Enter your name first.

upload.done: Jazākallāhu khayran. {sent, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} sent and will be reviewed.
upload.leaveWarning: Some files have not been sent yet.
upload.yourNameHint: So we know who sent these files.

admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: Uploads waiting for a decision. Watch one, and if it is worth the review time, choose the scholar and register it.
admin.signedOutHint: Only admins who have been added can get in.

login.denied: That Google address has not been added as an admin. Ask for it to be added.
login.failed: The sign-in did not work. Please try again.

admin.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up on this server yet.

waiting.title: Waiting for a decision ({count})
waiting.empty: Nothing is waiting. New uploads appear here.

admin.keptDespite: Kept although it matched something. Please listen to both:

scholar.label: Scholar
scholar.unclear: If you cannot tell who it is, just leave the video here.

admin.registerHint: Creates the entry. Its attribution stays “not sure” until someone sets it.

error.notWaiting: Someone has already dealt with this one. The list was reloaded.
error.unknownScholar: That scholar is not in the archive. Please choose again.
error.scholarExists: A scholar with that id already exists.
error.signedOut: You have been signed out. Please sign in again.
